profile: Actual BTCUSDC aggregate executed quantities in fixed 50-USDC price bins; top five separated smoothed peaks, each zone peak +/- one bin. Full 15m buckets with one-minute delay; current UTC session, rolling 1/7/60 days, latest confirmed 4h swing anchor. Two following 4h bars must finish before recognizing swing; anchor starts at original swing bar open, known only after confirmation. Overlapping periods are not independent evidence.
direction: Daily and 4h signs weight2, 1h and 15m weight1 define context only. A confirmed profile reaction may enter either side even against context. Counter-context additions capped at three tenths; otherwise five. This cap is a researcher assumption, not a user-confirmed rule.
controller: E055 capital/fees/halts retained. Context_timing requires two completed 3m closes to distinguish reclaim versus retest, plus completed 1m candle direction and close improvement. Same-zone re-additions allowed after fresh confirmation and a better price than last add or last reduction. Full flip needs opposite context or failure of the tactical/root zone in addition to opposite timing. No-add disables increases. All numeric rules are fixed research assumptions. v2 replaces redundant close-change confirmation with two completed 1m closes outside the zone and current completed 1m close beyond the prior completed 1m high/low. v1 results preserved; no profitability-based parameter selection.
comparison: 24 one-month accounts: frozen E055 multiscale baseline plus context_only, context_timing and no_add, each x1/3/5 leverage xbase/stress. context_only shares new inventory/flip/counter-context rules but retains old candle reaction; isolates the additional timing check. Baseline must reproduce frozen E055 exactly. No parameter search.
limitations: Reused historical August 2026, no fresh holdout
50-USDC bins and reaction rules are fixed researcher assumptions, not inferred user discretion
Trade volume is not outstanding orderbook liquidity or known holder cost basis
Average-cost PnL; newest allocation tracking inherits E054 pooled remnants
No validated exchange margin/liquidation or live fills
User leverage unspecified; 4% drawdown halt remains a provisional research guard
